title: Speedy service
content: Completed e consult form and 2 hrs later got telephone call from nurse practitioner, efficient and professional, request I attend to leave sample for testing, was seen within 10 mins of arrival and sample test done. Prescription issued. Very pleased with service. Credit where it's due .thanks
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
